transform_policy.note: CIRCUS composition uses preprocess_val for both query and gallery; native ENCODER uses preprocess_train (RandomResizedCrop) for the query and preprocess_val for the gallery. Keeping val for both is deliberate: the asymmetry is a property of the native release, and honouring it here would change every published number.

permutation_scope: whole model construction (CLIP tower, FactorNet, decoder heads and this tensor all draw from the seeded generator); the pin is what makes the run reproducible, not a claim that the released relation was recoverable
